description: This file defines the ModuleController class, which handles API requests related to 'modules' in the application. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting module records, utilizing a ModuleService for business logic. The class is part of the Api\V8\Controller namespace and extends BaseController.

classes.name: ModuleController
classes.description: Controller class for handling module-related API endpoints, providing CRUD operations via methods such as getModuleRecord, getModuleRecords, createModuleRecord, updateModuleRecord, and deleteModuleRecord.

methods.name: getModuleRecord
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of a single module record based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getModuleRecords
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of multiple module records, potentially with filtering or pagination.

methods.name: createModuleRecord
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new module record using provided request data.

methods.name: updateModuleRecord
methods.description: Handles updating an existing module record with new data.

methods.name: deleteModuleRecord
methods.description: Handles deletion of a module record identified by provided parameters.
